The '''Gild-Galaxy shops''' were a series of expensive shops located on the [[Bazaar Deck]] of the [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] [[Kuari Princess/Legends|''Kuari Princess'']]. They sold items of considerable quality and expense.
